name: Break Me, Princess
overview: When Lily Stone, an innocent orphan from a convent school, clashes with the academy’s cruel royalty, Princess Aurora Crownwell, a toxic survival game begins. Aurora is used to everyone kneeling before her, but Lily refuses to be broken. Forced to work together to save their futures, the tension between them escalates from brutal bullying into a passionate, forbidden love.
